title: Arize Bigante Plus (NSIC Rc 314H) Hybrid Rice: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: Arize Bigante Plus (NSIC Rc 314H) Rice: Yield and Maturity
metaDescription: Arize Bigante Plus is NSIC Rc 314H, a hybrid rice for irrigated lowland: about 118 days and 5.9 tonnes per hectare on average. See its ratings.
excerpt: NSIC Rc 314H is a hybrid rice variety for irrigated lowland, sold as Arize Bigante Plus or Bigante Plus and known locally as Mestiso 46. The NSIC approved it in 2013. Bayer bred it. It matures in about 118 days and averages 5.9 tonnes per hectare, with a top yield of 11.3 tonnes in trials.

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Arize Bigante Plus or Bigante Plus, or rice variety 314H, this is the one. items: **Yield:** 5.9 tonnes per hectare on average, or about 118 cavans of 50 kilograms. The best trial reached 11.3 tonnes.
**Watch out for:** tungro, green leafhopper, stem borer, sheath blight.
**Cooked rice:** intermediate amylose, so soft but not sticky.

blocks.text: How much does NSIC Rc 314H yield?

On average it gives 5.9 tonnes per hectare. That is about 118 cavans of 50 kilograms of palay. It sits below the average of the 180 irrigated lowland hybrids on the list, which is 6.9 tonnes. But the top yield, 11.3 tonnes, came from a trial with good water, seed and care. So plan your costs on the average, then work toward the top with the habits in our guide to [raising rice yield per hectare](/blog/increase-rice-yield-per-hectare).
How many days does it take to mature?

It takes about 118 days from sowing to harvest. Varieties of 100 to 120 days count as short duration and 120 to 140 days as medium, so this one counts as short duration. Then harvest when 85 to 90 percent of the grains turn golden yellow. Because the day count drives every task, anee.io counts it for you from each lot's own planting day, with the [growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.

blocks.text: So scout early for [tungro](/diseases/rice-tungro), [green leafhopper](/pests/green-leafhopper), [stem borer](/pests/rice-stem-borer), [sheath blight](/diseases/sheath-blight). When you see the first signs, check the guide before you spray, because the right timing saves more than an extra dose. If you are not sure what you see, our [pest and disease finders](/features/pest-and-disease-finders) help you name it from the damage.

Amylose decides how rice cooks. With intermediate amylose, expect rice that is soft but not sticky. In fact, Filipino taste has moved from high to intermediate and low amylose rice, because people want it softer. Head rice is the share of whole grains after milling. So a higher number means fewer broken grains and a better price at the mill.

items: **Days to harvest:** 111 to 115 days after sowing, a medium maturing hybrid.
**Yield:** 8.8 t/ha at the 16th National Rice Technology Forum in Hagonoy, Davao del Sur, second of 24 hybrids.
**How it is planted:** Direct seeded or transplanted.
**Seed:** 21 to 24 kg per hectare direct seeded, 15 kg transplanted.
About 114 cm tall, with 13 to 17 productive tillers.
Medium slender grain, with a milling recovery of 60 percent.
Bred to tolerate bacterial leaf blight.
Bayer calls it its steadiest medium maturing hybrid across places and seasons.

blocks.text: These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual variety on the same ground.

It suits irrigated lowland, where you control the water. Level the field well so the water stands evenly, and plant together with the farms around you, so pests cannot move from field to field. Our guide to [rice land preparation](/land-preparation/rice-land-preparation) shows each step. It is recommended for the dry season and the wet season. You can plant it dry direct seeded, transplanted or wet direct seeded. For the right month in your province, see [the best time to plant rice](/blog/best-time-to-plant-rice-philippines).

items.q: Is Arize Bigante Plus the same as NSIC Rc 314H?
items.a: Yes. Arize Bigante Plus is the name it is sold under, and NSIC Rc 314H is its registration with the National Seed Industry Council, where its local name is Mestiso 46. The numbers on this page are for NSIC Rc 314H.

items.q: What is the local name of NSIC Rc 314H?
items.a: It is known as Mestiso 46. Seed sellers and agriculturists use both names, so ask for either one.

items.q: How many days does NSIC Rc 314H take to harvest?
items.a: About 118 days after sowing. Then harvest when 85 to 90 percent of the grains are golden yellow.

items.q: What is the average yield of NSIC Rc 314H?
items.a: It averages 5.9 tonnes per hectare, about 118 cavans of 50 kilograms. The best trial reached 11.3 tonnes. Your own yield depends on water, seed, fertilizer and timing.

items.q: In which season should I plant it?
items.a: It is recommended for the dry season and the wet season. Then pick the month with our planting calendar guide and the forecast for your town.
Yes. So buy new seed each season, because seed saved from a hybrid crop does not grow true and yields less.
